subject: Hosted API evaluation — sandbox access and demo scheduling
messages:
From: SDR Intake <sdr-intake@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New PLG inbound — Craftly AI (Lydia Marsh) — Hosted API eval request

Hi Sean / Marissa,

New PLG lead came through the self-serve flow and requested a quick hosted API evaluation + sandbox access. Punting to SDR for scheduling & initial sandbox enable. Lead details below:

- Name: Lydia Marsh
- Title: Head of Product
- Company: Craftly AI
- Email: lydia@craftly.ai
- Notes: "Trying Redwood API for a latency-sensitive summarization feature. Looking for a 20-30 minute sandbox walkthrough and live token usage guidance. Interested in cost-per-token tradeoffs and quickstart code samples."

Original message from Lydia (forwarded):
> Hi Redwood —
>
> I signed up for the hosted API sandbox this morning and would love to schedule a short walkthrough with someone on the PLG team. Goal is to validate latency/cost on a 512-token summarization workload. Is there a quick window this week?
>
> Thanks,
> Lydia

Please propose two 30-minute windows and include the sandbox invite link + the quickstart PDF. I put Marissa on the thread for onboarding context.

— SDR Intake

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Marsh <lydia@craftly.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — sandbox access and demo scheduling

Hi Lydia — welcome, and thanks for signing up. I’m Sean on the PLG team, I’ll run the quick walkthrough and make sure you can hit the latency targets you mentioned.

I can do either of these 30-minute windows this week (PT):
- Thursday 2026-08-22 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Friday 2026-08-23 — 9:30–10:00 AM PT

If neither works, tell me a preferred timezone/time and I’ll adjust. I’ve attached a short quickstart (redwood-quickstart.pdf) that covers tokenized pricing and the sample summarization prompt. I also created a sandbox invite (.ics) and included a Zoom link in the calendar invite.

Prep notes for the session:
- Bring a sample input (or past logs) for a 512-token summary so we can replicate latency.
- I’ll show batching/kv-cache settings and a simple quantization suggestion to lower cost without losing quality.

Quick housekeeping: I’ll add Diego (onboarding lead) to the call if we decide a short integration pairing session is useful.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.pdf, sandbox-invite.ics

From: Lydia Marsh <lydia@craftly.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — sandbox access and demo scheduling

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick reply. I’m in EST (UTC-4) and Thursday 11:00 AM PT would be 2:00 PM my time, which works. Could we move to 2:30 PM ET though? I have a standing meeting that might run a bit long.

Also can you confirm whether the sandbox token is scoped to 100k tokens/day or if there’s a lower starter cap? If possible, we’d like a temporary bump for a short smoke test on Friday morning.

— Lydia
Head of Product, Craftly AI
lydia@craftly.ai | +1 646-555-0199

Lydia — 

2:30 PM ET on Thursday (2026-08-22 at 11:30 AM PT) works — I’ve updated the invite and attached the .ics. Zoom link is the same 
https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=demo

Regarding sandbox limits: default self-serve accounts start at 50k tokens/day. I’ve approved a temporary bump to 150k tokens/day for your account so you can run the smoke tests you mentioned on Friday morning. Diego is looped in to help with any integration follow-up and to make sure your account has the right logs/audit access for your security team. I also created a HubSpot record and you can view it here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
